notes.title: Demo Version 0.3.5 is Ready
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Demo version 0.3.5 is ready now.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] The undo function is upgraded, so now we can undo any action in the game.
[*] We have also added a new level, so don't forget to check it.
[*] Minor upgrade graphic quality.
[*] Fix some minor bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44480882/170e1838f2469761b5284fdd303820228f44817b.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to send us. We would love to hear any feedback from you.

Thank you
DD

notes.title: Demo Version 0.3 is Out
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just pushed the Demo version 0.3 out.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] We now have many save slots, so you can choose a new slot and play again without resetting the game.
[*] We also show the completion percentage. Make sure you complete 100% ;)
[*] The playtime will be shown with each save slot. Unfortunately, we can't get the playtime from previous versions. (In that case, it will be shown as --:--:--). We're so sorry for this inconvenience.
[*] Fix minor bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44480882/bc10a6ad7568cf56a13892d778549e6514923376.jpg[/img]

We're still working hard, and many new features will come soon. But first, let us know how long you will complete 100% :D

Thank you
DD

notes.title: September 2024 dev update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It has been a month since we published our demo and showed everyone to get a first look at our game. Thanks for the feedback from many players. It helps us know what to do with Memento Dawn to improve it. 

[h1]Update artwork[/h1]
We have some updates on our store page, including a new capsule image. The full version can also viewed on Steam Library if we play the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44480882/79d5274da3206c880d96ce9a86f2c80265b99602.png[/img]

All assets are downloadable from our presskit: https://oneelev.github.io/presskit/memendo_dawn


[h1]September development update[/h1]
We have been working hard on feedback from the players. One major feature we've added to the demo was the Undo function. Now, we can return to the previous point when playing the game by clicking on the Undo Button on the ui game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44480882/103f83d1e627ffd9e235afa1bffbce302e83f59b.png[/img]

We also sped up some character animations to push the game's pace and redesigned some levels to balance the difficult and make them more interesting.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We plan to add some new features in our next updates and are working on localization to bring the game to more languages. We also continue to fix bugs and improve the game.

Thanks for the feedback from players. As a tiny team, the players' support is precious and helps us save a lot of time. We truly appreciate and hope everybody continues to support us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319360/Memento_Dawn/

Thanks
DD

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2 is Ready
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that the Demo version 0.2 is ready.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add Undo function. Now, the players can return to the previous photos they got.
[*] Speed up character movement.
[*] Update the claim photo animation to be shorter if it's not the final photo.
[*] Add some new sound effects.
[*] Fix minor bugs
[/list]

Thank you all for trying our demo. We've been listening and working hard to improve the game, so please continue to support us. We're here and always open to any feedback.

Thank you
DD
